Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

SettingsTenantAdminSetting.description: One declared setting item as the tenant management surface shows it. The declaration fields come from the key table; written and has_row come from that tenant layer's rows, and value and source from the resolved read. Every value-bearing field is text in the declared type's own form, so a duration reads as "5m0s" rather than as a count of nanoseconds.

default.description: The declared default in the declared type's text form, empty for a sensitive item

description.description: The human-readable text the declaring module gave the item.

domain.description: The declared rule over the item's values, empty when every value of the type is admitted

has_row.description: Whether the tenant layer holds a row for the item. For a non-sensitive item, written is empty both when no row is held and when the row's text is empty; a sensitive item's written is the mask string whether or not a row exists.

key.description: The full setting key: the declaring module's namespace joined with the item's own segment by a dot.

namespace.description: The module that declared the item

sensitive.description: Whether the item is a credential. A sensitive item's default is empty and its written and value carry a fixed mask string; has_row still reports whether the tenant layer holds a row.

source.description: The layer the reported value comes from: "tenant" when this tenant layer holds an explicit row, "global" when it does not and the global layer does, "default" when neither does and the value is the declared default.

type.description: The declared type's name as reflection reports it, such as "string", "int", "bool" or "time.Duration"; the item's values are stored and rendered in that type's text form.

value.description: The text the item resolves to after the three-level fallback, the mask string for a sensitive item

written.description: The text the tenant layer holds, the mask string for a sensitive item

get.description: Returns every item in the declaration listing, including keys declared by modules that do not run in this process, each with the value it resolves to on the layer of the tenant in the path. The platform-only namespaces are left out. Resolution walks the three-level fallback: the tenant row, then the global row, then the declared default; source reports which of the three the value came from. Every value-bearing field is text in the declared type's own form; for a sensitive item default is empty and written and value carry a fixed mask string. A failure to read the layer's rows or to resolve a value answers 503 rather than leaving the item out.

parameters.description: The tenant whose settings layer the read addresses, named in the path. The layer and the policy domain are both fixed to it; a "layer" or "tenant" query parameter is refused with 400.
parameters.name: tenant

400.description: A layer or tenant query parameter was sent, or the tenant in the path is outside the tenant identifier's value domain

403.description: The caller holds no settings.tenant.read in the tenant's domain

get.summary: List every declared setting with its value on the tenant layer

get.description: Returns the declared items whose namespace equals the path segment, that is the group one module declared, each carrying the same fields and resolved the same way as on the all-items route. The declaration listing is not narrowed to the modules running in this process, and the platform-only namespaces are left out. A namespace no declared item belongs to, or one whose items are all platform-only, answers 404 without a problem document.

parameters.description: The tenant whose settings layer the read addresses, named in the path. A "layer" or "tenant" query parameter is refused with 400.
parameters.name: tenant

parameters.description: The namespace whose declared items the listing returns: the declaring module, which is the key's leading segment (for example "deals" or "authn.session"). A namespace no declared item belongs to, or one whose items are all platform-only, is a 404.
parameters.name: namespace

400.description: A layer or tenant query parameter was sent, or the tenant in the path is outside the tenant identifier's value domain

403.description: The caller holds no settings.tenant.read in the tenant's domain

404.description: No declared item belongs to the namespace, or the namespace is platform-only

get.summary: List the declared settings one namespace declares on the tenant layer

delete.description: Drops the layer of the tenant in the path's explicit row for the setting named by the namespace and key path segments. The full key `<namespace>.<key>` must match a declared item and must not belong to a platform-only namespace, otherwise the answer is 404; deleting a row the layer does not hold is not an error. Once the row is gone the item resolves through the fallback again. The host's settings write seam is asked before anything is changed; a refusal is 403 protected and an unreadable answer is 503. A mandatory audit row is written before the change, and if it cannot be written the row is left in place and the answer is 503. The change is attributed to the caller's accountability key, which under an impersonation is the administrator making the request rather than the account impersonated. Success is 204 with no body.

parameters.description: The tenant whose settings layer the row is dropped from, named in the path. A "layer" or "tenant" query parameter is refused with 400.
parameters.name: tenant

parameters.description: The namespace of the item whose row is dropped: the declaring module, which is the key's leading segment. Joined with "key" by a dot to form the full key, which must be declared and not platform-only.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: The rest of the setting key under the namespace; dots are allowed. Joined with the namespace by a dot to form the full key, which must be declared and not platform-only.
parameters.name: key

400.description: A layer or tenant query parameter was sent, or the tenant in the path is outside its value domain

403.description: The caller holds no settings.tenant.write in the tenant's domain, the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required), or the host's settings write seam refused the write (protected)

404.description: The full key has no declaration, or its namespace is platform-only

delete.summary: Drop the tenant layer's explicit row for one setting

put.description: Writes one row for the setting named by the namespace and key path segments on the layer of the tenant in the path. The full key `<namespace>.<key>` must match a declared item and must not belong to a platform-only namespace, otherwise the answer is 404. The host's settings write seam is asked before anything is changed; a refusal is 403 protected and an unreadable answer is 503. The value is encoded under the item's declared type and then held to its declared domain, so a duration written as "300s" is stored as "5m0s"; a value that cannot be encoded, lies outside the domain, or exceeds the size limit answers 422. A mandatory audit row is written before the change, and if it cannot be written the setting is left untouched and the answer is 503. The change is attributed to the caller's accountability key, which under an impersonation is the administrator making the request rather than the account impersonated. Success is 204 with no body.

parameters.description: The tenant whose settings layer the write lands on, named in the path. A "layer" or "tenant" query parameter is refused with 400.
parameters.name: tenant

parameters.description: The namespace of the item to write: the declaring module, which is the key's leading segment. Joined with "key" by a dot to form the full key, which must be declared and not platform-only.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: The rest of the setting key under the namespace; dots are allowed. Joined with the namespace by a dot to form the full key, which must be declared and not platform-only.
parameters.name: key

value.description: The value to store, in the JSON form the item's declared type is read from: a string for a string, duration, or text-decoding item, a number for a numeric item, a boolean for a bool item. It is encoded under the declared type and then held to the item's declared domain; a value that cannot be encoded, lies outside the domain, or exceeds the size limit answers 422.

requestBody.description: The write's body: exactly one object, whose `value` member carries the value to store.

400.description: A layer or tenant query parameter was sent, the tenant in the path is outside its value domain, or the body is not one object

403.description: The caller holds no settings.tenant.write in the tenant's domain, the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required), or the host's settings write seam refused the write (protected)

404.description: The full key has no declaration, or its namespace is platform-only

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

415.description: The request body is not application/json

422.description: The value cannot be encoded under the declared type or lies outside its declared domain

put.summary: Write one setting row on the tenant layer
